data.name: Merge Co.
data.detailed_description:
Merge Co.

Build the ultimate toy collection!

Merge Co. is a cozy and satisfying merge game where you combine adorable toys to unlock bigger, rarer, and more valuable collectibles. Merge matching toys, discover exciting new creations, and fill your toy box with unique treasures!

Every merge brings a new surprise. With simple mechanics and relaxing gameplay, Merge Co. is perfect whether you're playing for a few minutes or settling in for a long, cozy session.

Features

🧸 Discover hundreds of adorable toys.

✨ Merge identical toys to create new and more valuable ones.

🎁 Unlock rare and special collectibles.

🌈 Enjoy a colorful, cozy, and relaxing atmosphere.

🏆 Complete your collection and discover every toy.

🎮 Easy to learn, satisfying to master.

Every Merge is a New Discovery!

Start with simple toys and work your way up to colorful trains, cute robots, rockets, cars, and many more delightful collectibles. Plan your merges, manage your space wisely, and build the ultimate toy collection.

With charming visuals, relaxing music, and satisfying merge effects, Merge Co. delivers a cozy experience that's fun for players of all ages.

Merge. Discover. Collect.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10 / 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3-4160 / AMD CPU with 4 physical cores @ 3Ghz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GT 760 2GB / AMD Radeon R9 270X
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:

  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7-7700 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1660 6GB / AMD Radeon R9 390X
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
